description: Quick technical and SEO audit of a public web page: HTTPS and redirect, status, response time, title and meta description, viewport (mobile), h1, canonical, Open Graph, alt text, structured data, compression and security headers. Returns a 0-100 score, grade and prioritized issues. Send {url}. Charged only if the page could be fetched. Paid tool: 0.02 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].
name: web_audit
title: Web page audit
